outcome: rate of uterine atony or other etiologies of hemorrhage
cohort: The study included 891 patients who experienced postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) out of 6732 deliveries between 1 August 2020 and 31 July 2022.
finding: BMI alone does not appear to be directly associated with the use of ≥2 uterotonics in patients experiencing postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Patients with higher BMIs were more likely to require cesarean delivery, have a classical hysterotomy incision, and have a hysterotomy extension.
